commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to ET
commitResults.messageBody: Update the Java entry point, startup banner, and user documentation to use the new chatbot name.
Record intermediate Java and IntelliJ IDEA experience for more appropriately tailored project guidance.

commitResults.messageTitle: Give ET a friendly extraterrestrial personality
commitResults.messageBody: Update the chatbot greeting, prompt, farewell, and setup documentation to match ET's curious space-themed voice.
Give ET a gentle, homesick voice inspired by the film while preserving command echoing and bye handling, and update the setup example to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add in-memory task storage and list command

commitResults.messageBody: Add in-memory completion state and support the mark command with task-number validation. Display completion markers in list output and ignore the project-local visual diff skill files.
Support reversing a task's done status with unmark and report the updated task state. Validate task numbers consistently with the existing mark command.
Represent task descriptions and completion state in a dedicated Task class. Delegate status changes and display formatting from ET to Task while preserving the existing task commands.

Represent ToDos, deadlines, and events in a single task model without inheritance, preserving date and time values as strings. Parse the new todo, deadline, and event commands, display type-specific details, and document the updated task syntax.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor task types to use inheritance
commitResults.messageBody: Move shared task state and completion behaviour into the Task base class. Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses that render type-specific information, and store them polymorphically in a fixed Task array.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add documented console UI testing workflow
commitResults.messageBody: Create the project-specific test-ui skill and Markdown test plan for exact console-output checks. Require agents to update relevant UI cases and run the skill after each code change, with fail-fast reporting for mismatches.

Introduce ETException for invalid user commands and route task parsing and task-number validation through it. Unknown commands, missing task details, malformed dates, and invalid task references now produce helpful messages without changing the task list or completion state.\n\nAdd interleaved console UI cases that verify invalid deadline and event commands do not create tasks or alter existing task status.
